nb.debugger.name.description: Name of the NitroBolt debugger extension

pen.allPapers.description: report the names of all pen drawing layers

pen.clearPaper.description: erase all pen trails and stamps from a named pen drawing layer

pen.combinePapers.description: copy or merge the pixels from one pen drawing layer into another

pen.createPaper.description: create a named pen drawing layer

pen.currentPaper.description: report the name of the selected pen drawing layer

pen.paperExists.description: check whether a named pen drawing layer exists

pen.paperIndex.description: report the stacking index of a named pen drawing layer

pen.paperIsVisible.description: check whether a named pen drawing layer is visible

pen.paperVisibilityMenu.hide.description: hide option in the pen paper visibility menu

pen.paperVisibilityMenu.show.description: show option in the pen paper visibility menu

pen.printColorTargetMenu.fill.description: fill option in the pen print color menu

pen.printColorTargetMenu.stroke.description: stroke option in the pen print color menu

pen.printText.description: draw text on the selected pen paper

pen.removePaper.description: remove a named pen drawing layer

pen.setPaperIndex.description: set the stacking index of a named pen drawing layer

pen.setPaperVisibility.description: show or hide a named pen drawing layer

pen.setPrintAlignment.description: set the horizontal alignment used by the pen print block

pen.setPrintColor.description: set the fill or outline color used by the pen print block

pen.setPrintFont.description: set the font used by the pen print block

pen.setPrintFontSize.description: set the font size used by the pen print block

pen.setPrintFontWeight.description: set the font weight used by the pen print block

pen.setPrintItalic.description: turn italics on or off for the pen print block

pen.setPrintStrokeWidth.description: set the outline width used by the pen print block

pen.setPrintWordWrap.description: turn word wrapping on or off for the pen print block

pen.switchPaper.description: select the pen drawing layer used by pen blocks
